hints.title: Compute from Right to Left
hints.text: Because powers increase from left to right in the given formula, rolling backwards from right to left avoids modular division.

hints.title: Backward Rolling Hash Formula
hints.text: Moving from window starting at i + 1 to i, subtract the outgoing right element multiplied by p^(k-1), multiply the rest by p, and add the incoming element.

hints.title: Select Earliest Match
hints.text: Whenever the window hash equals hashValue while rolling backwards, update the recorded result index so that the earliest occurrence wins.

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recalculating polynomial hashes of length k for all N - k substrings takes O(N * k) time.
